body:
bazel build failed outright (missing humanness.h). Installed bazelisk, iteratively fixed 6 BUILD.bazel files until bazel build //apps/lobby:shank_lobby //apps/server:shank_server succeeds clean. Commit 5cd4de3.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix Bazel build: BUILD.bazel was never kept in sync with Makefile past phase 1
